split: existing seed-42 NC split; test labels masked immediately after load
checkpoint_selection: original fixed best_val_accuracy checkpoints; no retraining or reselection

definitions.neighbor_pairwise_rms_gap: RMS similarity difference over unordered distinct neighbors, computed exactly from within-neighborhood population variance
definitions.relative_neighbor_pairwise_rms_gap: per-node neighbor-pairwise RMS gap divided by global physical-edge cosine standard deviation
definitions.q_perturbation: permute q rows with fixed seed 20261013; propagation banks, learned relation operators, features, model and head are held fixed; metrics use validation nodes only
definitions.attention_contribution: attention increment and its order-differential component; denominator is RMS(B_k-B_0), k=1..K
definitions.eta_saturation: fraction with |eta_k| >= 0.45, i.e. within 10% of the tanh bound 0.5, reported separately for each order and modality
definitions.residual_ratio: per-node RMS of raw U or gated U divided by per-node RMS of the original projected modality representation H0
